text.text_excerpt: I loved Brisbi's. I think I love any place where I can sit and look out on water. Considering I didn't grow up in Florida, the lake is the closest I can get to experiencing this. Me and a group of other Yelpers met here on a lovely afternoon for happy hour. We all sat outside on the patio which allowed us to enjoy the view, breathe in the fresh air and mingle freely with one another. Some chose this spot because of their debris fries and I was pretty happy when I saw oysters and shrimp and grits on the menu. The raw oysters were yummy and obviously fresh and the shrimp and grits made me wish I had ordered the full entree and not just the appetizer. The grits were nice and creamy and the t...

My mom comes in to town about once or twice per year. She always wants to go out to eat and I know to her this means a seafood platter. No matter where we go she always orders one even though 90 percent of the time she eats less than a quarter of one. Anyway, that's what brought me to Brisbi's. They have one on their menu and I have never been so Brisbi's it was. We came here on a Friday night and originally we planned to sit on their patio but of course the weather didn't cooperate. We had 5 people in our party so we started off with 3 apps and I started with a Sazerac since I needed the drink after having 4 women in my house for a week. (yeah yeah I'm being sexist. I took the family here for lunch last weekend and it was a very pleasant experience. The atmosphere has a casual clean feel. Super high ceilings make the dining area feel more spacious than it is. It looks like there are the same amount of outdoor seating as there is inside. I loved how even the indoor seating has the option to enjoy a pretty day but with the comforts of being inside. It all overlooks the marina and you can easily dock your boat or park your car to enjoy a lovely meal. We tried the gumbo, bbq shrimp stuffed poboy and buffalo fried oysters( special request) over their wedge salad. The shrimp in the gumbo were cheap but the fried and Bbq versions were top quality.
